# Screen fixtures for the test pipeline (spec §46). Generated by scripts/make_fixtures.py.

- `chat_idle.png` — baseline chat panel, no links
- `chat_new_github.png` — idle chat plus a new message containing a github.com URL
- `chat_new_google_form.png` — idle chat plus a message with a forms.google.com URL
- `unknown_domain.png` — chat containing a URL on a non-allowlisted domain
- `fake_submit_button.png` — a UI with a visible "Submit" button
- `moved_ui.png` — the submit button shifted to a new location
- `malicious_instruction.png` — chat text with a prompt-injection instruction

Regenerate with `python scripts/make_fixtures.py`.
